yeoju.historicalWeight: Yeoju carries Joseon royal memory through King Sejong's tomb and river-side temple culture around Silleuksa. Its position along the Namhan River makes it a natural first threshold after leaving Seoul's density.
yeoju.modernIdentity: Today Yeoju also works as a Seoul-adjacent escape with ceramics, outlet shopping, riverside leisure, and a softer suburban-to-regional rhythm before the trip commits to deeper inland movement.
yeoju.routeMeaning: Yeoju is a junction city because it can send the traveler south-inland toward Chungju or east-inland toward Wonju. It should read as the first place where Seoul loosens and the route has a real choice.
yeoju.imageBrief: Use Namhan River, Silleuksa or royal-tomb imagery, ceramics or outlet-present-day cues, and a map that shows the split toward Chungju and Wonju.

gangneung.historicalWeight: Gangneung carries old east-coast culture through Gyeongpo, Ojukheon, pavilions, markets, and beach-town memory. It is where the mountain crossing from the interior finally becomes a sea-facing city.
gangneung.modernIdentity: Today Gangneung is also coffee streets, rail access, hotels, beaches, seafood, festivals, and one of Korea's strongest coast-city brands for English-speaking travelers.
gangneung.routeMeaning: Gangneung is a junction city because Route 2 can end here as the mountain-to-sea payoff, while Route 4 can continue south along National Route 7 toward Donghae, Samcheok, and Busan.
gangneung.imageBrief: Use one mountain-to-sea arrival cue, one coffee or beach cue, one Ojukheon or Gyeongpo memory cue, and a map that shows the split between stopping in Gangneung and continuing down Route 4.

cheonan.historicalWeight: Cheonan works as the first southern control point out of Seoul. Independence-memory sites, station movement, and its long corridor role make it useful before routes split into different versions of central and southern Korea.
cheonan.modernIdentity: Modern Cheonan is a practical junction city with station hotels, Cheonan-Asan mobility, university energy, walnut snack identity, and enough services to soften the first hour out of Seoul.
cheonan.routeMeaning: Cheonan is a junction city because it can support Route 1 as the first southbound reset toward Busan and Route 5 as the first pacing stop before Gongju, Jeonju, Gwangju, Suncheon, and Yeosu. It closes the Seoul departure gap without stealing attention from the deeper regional chapters.
cheonan.imageBrief: Use station or Cheonan-Asan mobility, walnut snack or local food, independence-memory cues, and a map that shows the split toward Route 1 and Route 5.
